Workbook (read in memory via zipfile, 'Quality Checks' row 5 / #4.0 and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 5): 'Everything the judges grade is actually asked for, and the hard runtime facts the verifier needs (path, start command, port, storage/DB_PATH, health path, fixed clock, seed, accounts) are stated ... (Network is public in this project - no no-network constraint to state.)'. The internal sheet's older 'no-network' wording is superseded by the public sheet and the SKILL.md delivery profile (network public). Followed skill references/quality-checks.md #4: built the runtime fact list, then read every criterion and checked each graded demand against the brief/notes.

RUNTIME FACTS (all stated; frozen task .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/task):
- Path /app: instruction.md:15 'Put the application in /app'.
- Start command: instruction.md:15 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5,21. Matches tests/test.sh:97-111 (task test.sh byte-identical to template; diff empty).
- Port: instruction.md:15 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 'port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'. test.sh injects PORT=3000; all five prompts open http://localhost:3000; app_context.md:4.
- Storage/DB_PATH: instruction.md:15 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8,23; hireops_rules.md:208-209. test.sh:98-109 injects DB_PATH.
- Health: instruction.md:15 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10. test.sh probe_ready uses /api/health then /.
- Seed: instruction.md:15,17 '/assets/seed_data.json', 'Copy what you need into /app; /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime. Load ... once, start with no shipped database, and keep new work across restarts'; hireops_rules.md:213-218 explains read_count semantics and that candidate wording and page size 30 are in the seed.
- Accounts: instruction.md:19 password Hireops!2026 and all 10 emails with roles; identical to tests/app_context.md:8-19 and to seed users.
- Fixed clock: N-A. No criterion or prompt grades a date, time or relative age (grep of all judge.toml/prompt.md for timestamp/today/clock/2026- found only Date.now() inside the judge's own timing protocol). Seed created_at values only order messages/notes.
- Launch environment: hireops_rules.md:207-211 names exactly the env test.sh passes (PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT, DB_PATH), the locked-down user, other cwd and writable copy; integration.md:16-23 covers the symlink policy (test.sh:72-83) and file resolution. Preinstalled deps: instruction.md:15 'don't install packages'; integration.md:3-5 Express + better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH (environment/Dockerfile:9-12).
- Restart: instruction.md:17 'keep new work across restarts'; integration.md:8-10.
- Network: public; instruction.md:15 allows CDN on the browser side and forbids an outside data service for the server. Nothing further to state.
- HTTP statuses graded: 409 (hro_two_people) stated hireops_rules.md:79-81; 401/403/404 (hro_readonly_roles, hro_messaging, hro_candidate) stated hireops_rules.md:22-24.

- hro_activity: rules:115-119 (opening/add/move/reject with reason/reopen/re-order/undo, newest first, all or one job, refused leaves no line); Observer reads (rules:19).
- hro_manager_roles: rules:70-74,108-109.
- hro_readonly_roles: rules:19-24,74,137-141,202-203 ('gets nothing back' for 401).

- hro_unread_seen: rules:158-173; Lena = 1 is derivable (seed APP-301 has 3 messages, the 3rd by USR-REC3; reads USR-CAN3 read_count 2); Mei never opened so counts others' messages (rules:158-160); candidate opens a conversation by choice (rules:188-189).

- Visual: desktop craft only; phone layout and theme switching explicitly excluded (instruction.md:11; visual prompt.md:14).
No graded route, selector, label, transport or storage location is required: app_context.md:37-38; rules:3-5; 'Where drafts are kept is up to you'; 'Polling, server-sent events and sockets are all fine'.

Lessons file (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md) patterns bearing on this row, checked at every instance: lesson 1 (no hidden or golden-only demands) - none found across all criteria and gate texts; lesson 13 (public address in judge prompts) - every prompt uses localhost only; lesson 18 (unstated save-transport line) - failed_send accepts a request abort or setOffline and the brief leaves transport open; lesson 8 modifier-click guidance in app_context.md:33-35 is judge procedure, not a product demand.

Plausible broken app vs conforming alternative: a conforming app binding 127.0.0.1, ignoring PORT, or reading files from cwd would fail, but each of those is stated (integration.md:5-6, instruction.md:15, rules:207-209), so the failure is fair. A conforming app keeping its session only in JS memory is the one alternative that could fail on a fact stated only by implication (note 1).

Evidence-index hashes verified with sha256sum: workspace.cjs da3eafc6..., results/workspace.json 662829b4..., solution/app/src/index.js 708f94cb..., server.js 4fc5d2c4... all match raw-evidence-index.json. This is a source/text row; runtime evidence is not required for it, and no Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.

NOTES (non-blocking, P3):
1. 'Still signed in after reload' is a hard gate in every suite but is only implied (instruction.md:7 and rules:177-179 list reloading separately from the session ending; rules:11 server-issued session; instruction.md:13 'reload, and make sure nothing breaks'). An app holding its session only in JS memory would hit a gate zero. Optional hardening: add 'and I stay signed in when I reload' to the brief.
2. hro_undo step 5 does not fix the direction of Mei's re-order of Y; if Y is moved below A2, an app that treats A2's displaced position as 're-ordered since' (rules:101) could refuse the undo. That ambiguity belongs to row 6; the fix would be 'move Y up one place'.
3. DB_PATH honouring is stated, but test.sh passes the default path, so an app ignoring DB_PATH is not distinguished; stating it is enough for this row.
